faqs.answer: You can find all available scholarships in the 'Career Gateway -> Scholarships' section. We list merit-based, need-based, and category-specific (SC/ST/OBC) scholarships from both government and private sources.
The 'Entrance Exams' section in the Career Gateway provides details on various national and state-level exams, including eligibility, syllabus, and important dates.
Check out the 'Jobs After 10th' and 'Jobs After 12th' sections in the Career Gateway. We also list skill-based internships and vocational training opportunities.
You can take timed mock tests in the 'Test Series' section or practice specific subjects in the 'Practice' section. Both offer instant grading and performance badges.
My Locker is a secure space where you can upload and store your academic certificates and identity documents for quick access during applications.
The 'Career Roadmap' tool helps you plan your journey from school to your dream career by suggesting courses and exams based on your interests.
You can track your attendance for all enrolled courses in the 'Attendance' section on your dashboard. It shows your monthly and overall presence percentage.
Use the 'Doubt Clearance' section to post questions to your teachers. You can also see responses from teachers and other students here.
